title: BCA Jing Sima：消费疲软无政策支撑，中国经济再平衡在工业端
speaker: Jing Sima

segments.en: we don't agree to Chinese MCI China index basically because the heavy weight of consumer facing e-commerce in that index
segments.zh: 我们不同意中国MCI中国指数，因为该指数中面向消费者的电子商务权重过高

segments.en: so we I think for the rest of the year we're not seeing any policy support any meaningful policy support in the consumption consumer sector so I think that play probably we're staying we're maintaining our call for the rest of the year at least
segments.zh: 我们认为今年剩余时间看不到任何有意义的政策支持消费领域，所以我们维持看空观点

segments.en: that's fairly non-consensus most economists that we talked to here think that the consumption stories about to pick up yeah well we have a contrarian view here because I think our structural view is that if we think about Chinese economic rebalancing we're actually thinking differently
segments.zh: 这相当非共识，大多数经济学家认为消费即将回暖，但我们持相反观点，因为我们对经济再平衡的看法不同

segments.en: we're not thinking that policymakers are going to meaningfully boost consumption or consumer sector while consumption really is driven by mostly three things you know job security wage growth and also households willingness to take on more loans and none of the three is happening in China
segments.zh: 我们认为政策制定者不会大幅提振消费，因为消费主要由三件事驱动：工作保障、工资增长和家庭借贷意愿，而这三件事在中国都没有发生

segments.en: and without any meaningful policy support any structural reforms this is not happening you know we're not seeing any meaningful pickup in consumption rather I think the economic rebalancing is happening in the manufacturing or industrial supply chains
segments.zh: 没有有意义的政策支持和结构性改革，消费不会回暖。相反，经济再平衡正在制造业或工业供应链中发生
